     2	name: frontend-design
     3	description: Expert frontend design guidelines for creating beautiful, modern UIs. Use when building landing pages, dashboards, or any user interface.
     4	metadata: {"clawdbot":{"emoji":"🎨"}}
     5	---
     6	
     7	# Frontend Design Skill
     8	
     9	Use this skill when creating UI components, landing pages, dashboards, or any frontend design work.
    10	
    11	## Design Workflow
    12	
    13	Follow this structured approach for UI design:
    14	
    15	1. **Layout Design** — Think through component structure, create ASCII wireframes
    16	2. **Theme Design** — Define colors, fonts, spacing, shadows
    17	3. **Animation Design** — Plan micro-interactions and transitions
    18	4. **Implementation** — Generate the actual code
    19	
    20	### 1. Layout Design
    21	
    22	Before coding, sketch the layout in ASCII format:
    23	
    24	```
    25	┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
    26	│         HEADER / NAV BAR            │
    27	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    28	│                                     │
    29	│            HERO SECTION             │
    30	│         (Title + CTA)               │
    31	│                                     │
    32	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    33	│   FEATURE   │  FEATURE  │  FEATURE  │
    34	│     CARD    │   CARD    │   CARD    │
    35	├─────────────────────────────────────┤
    36	│            FOOTER                   │
    37	└─────────────────────────────────────┘
    38	```
    39	
    40	### 2. Theme Guidelines
    41	
    42	**Color Rules:**
    43	- NEVER use generic bootstrap-style blue (#007bff) — it looks dated
    44	- Prefer oklch() for modern color definitions
    45	- Use semantic color variables (--primary, --secondary, --muted, etc.)
    46	- Consider both light and dark mode from the start
    47	
    48	**Font Selection (Google Fonts):**
    49	```
    50	Sans-serif: Inter, Roboto, Poppins, Montserrat, Outfit, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Space Grotesk
    51	Monospace: JetBrains Mono, Fira Code, Source Code Pro, IBM Plex Mono, Space Mono, Geist Mono
    52	Serif: Merriweather, Playfair Display, Lora, Source Serif Pro, Libre Baskerville
    53	Display: Architects Daughter, Oxanium
    54	```
    55	
    56	**Spacing & Shadows:**
    57	- Use consistent spacing scale (0.25rem base)
    58	- Shadows should be subtle — avoid heavy drop shadows
    59	- Consider using oklch() for shadow colors too
    60	
    61	### 3. Theme Patterns
    62	
    63	**Modern Dark Mode (Vercel/Linear style):**
    64	```css
    65	:root {
    66	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    67	  --foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0);
    68	  --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0);
    69	  --primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0);
    70	  --secondary: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    71	  --muted: oklch(0.970 0 0);
    72	  --muted-foreground: oklch(0.556 0 0);
    73	  --border: oklch(0.922 0 0);
    74	  --radius: 0.625rem;
    75	  --font-sans: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif;
    76	}
    77	```
    78	
    79	**Neo-Brutalism (90s web revival):**
    80	```css
    81	:root {
    82	  --background: oklch(1 0 0);
    83	  --foreground: oklch(0 0 0);
    84	  --primary: oklch(0.649 0.237 26.97);
    85	  --secondary: oklch(0.968 0.211 109.77);
    86	  --accent: oklch(0.564 0.241 260.82);
    87	  --border: oklch(0 0 0);
    88	  --radius: 0px;
    89	  --shadow: 4px 4px 0px 0px hsl(0 0% 0%);
    90	  --font-sans: DM Sans, sans-serif;
    91	  --font-mono: Space Mono, monospace;
    92	}
    93	```
    94	
    95	**Glassmorphism:**
    96	```css
    97	.glass {
    98	  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    99	  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
   100	  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
   101	  border-radius: 1rem;
   102	}
   103	```
   104	
   105	### 4. Animation Guidelines
   106	
   107	**Micro-syntax for planning:**
   108	```
   109	button: 150ms [S1→0.95→1] press
   110	hover: 200ms [Y0→-2, shadow↗]
   111	fadeIn: 400ms ease-out [Y+20→0, α0→1]
   112	slideIn: 350ms ease-out [X-100→0, α0→1]
   113	bounce: 600ms [S0.95→1.05→1]
   114	```
   115	
   116	**Common patterns:**
   117	- Entry animations: 300-500ms, ease-out
   118	- Hover states: 150-200ms
   119	- Button press: 100-150ms
   120	- Page transitions: 300-400ms
   121	
   122	### 5. Implementation Rules
   123	
   124	**Tailwind CSS:**
   125	```html
   126	<!-- Import via CDN for prototypes -->
   127	<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
   128	```
   129	
   130	**Flowbite (component library):**
   131	```html
   132	<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
   133	<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/flowbite@2.0.0/dist/flowbite.min.js"></script>
   134	```
   135	
   136	**Icons (Lucide):**
   137	```html
   138	<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>
   139	<script>lucide.createIcons();</script>
   140	```
   141	
   142	**Images:**
   143	- Use real placeholder services: Unsplash, placehold.co
   144	- Never make up image URLs
   145	- Example: `https://images.unsplash.com/photo-xxx?w=800&h=600`
   146	
   147	### 6. Responsive Design
   148	
   149	Always design mobile-first and responsive:
   150	
   151	```css
   152	/* Mobile first */
   153	.container { padding: 1rem; }
   154	
   155	/* Tablet */
   156	@media (min-width: 768px) {
   157	  .container { padding: 2rem; }
   158	}
   159	
   160	/* Desktop */
   161	@media (min-width: 1024px) {
   162	  .container { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
   163	}
   164	```
   165	
   166	### 7. Accessibility
   167	
   168	- Use semantic HTML (header, main, nav, section, article)
   169	- Include proper heading hierarchy (h1 → h2 → h3)
   170	- Add aria-labels to interactive elements
   171	- Ensure sufficient color contrast (4.5:1 minimum)
   172	- Support keyboard navigation
   173	
   174	### 8. Component Design Tips
   175	
   176	**Cards:**
   177	- Subtle shadows, not heavy drop shadows
   178	- Consistent padding (p-4 to p-6)
   179	- Hover state: slight lift + shadow increase
   180	
   181	**Buttons:**
   182	- Clear visual hierarchy (primary, secondary, ghost)
   183	- Adequate touch targets (min 44x44px)
   184	- Loading and disabled states
   185	
   186	**Forms:**
   187	- Clear labels above inputs
   188	- Visible focus states
   189	- Inline validation feedback
   190	- Adequate spacing between fields
   191	
   192	**Navigation:**
   193	- Sticky header for long pages
   194	- Clear active state indication
   195	- Mobile-friendly hamburger menu
   196	
   197	---
   198	
   199	## Quick Reference
   200	
   201	| Element | Recommendation |
   202	|---------|---------------|
   203	| Primary font | Inter, Outfit, DM Sans |
   204	| Code font | JetBrains Mono, Fira Code |
   205	| Border radius | 0.5rem - 1rem (modern), 0 (brutalist) |
   206	| Shadow | Subtle, 1-2 layers max |
   207	| Spacing | 4px base unit (0.25rem) |
   208	| Animation | 150-400ms, ease-out |
   209	| Colors | oklch() for modern, avoid generic blue |
   210	
   211	---
   212	
   213	*Based on SuperDesign patterns — https://superdesign.dev*

steps.message:
The Fresh Pantry landing page has been built and saved to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was implemented following the `frontend-design` skill workflow:

### Design System
- **Colors:** Brand palette from the brief — forest green (`#2D6A4F`), warm accent orange (`#F4A261`), soft cream (`#FEFAE0`)
- **Typography:** Nunito (rounded, friendly) for headings + Inter for body text
- **Spacing:** Generous whitespace, rounded corners (1–1.5rem), subtle shadows

### Sections Implemented
1. **Sticky Header** — Logo + nav links (Products, Our Stores, Recipes, About Us) with mobile hamburger menu
2. **Hero** — Brand headline, subtitle, and two CTAs ("Find a Store Near You", "Explore This Week's Picks")
3. **Brand Highlights Banner** — Bold stats (500+ stores, 4,000+ products, 80% private label, weekly new arrivals) on a green background
4. **Featured Products Carousel** — 8 product cards with left/right arrow navigation that smooth-scrolls horizontally
5. **Seasonal Picks** — 4 summer product cards in a responsive grid
6. **Product Categories** — 5 category cards with scale-up + overlay hover effect
7. **Store Locator** — Zip code input + search button that reveals 3 mock store results with distance badges
8. **Newsletter** — Email input + subscribe button with confirmation message
9. **Footer** — Full navigation columns (Shop, Company, Help, Follow Us) + copyright

### Interactions
- **Carousel:** Arrow buttons scroll by card width with smooth behavior
- **Category hover:** `scale(1.04)` + green overlay fade-in (300ms ease-out)
- **Store search:** Validates input, then animates mock results in with staggered slide-down
- **Newsletter:** Validates email, hides form, shows confirmation message with pop-in animation
- **Mobile menu:** Toggleable hamburger nav

### Output
- Single-file `index.html` at `/app/output/index.html`
- No build step required — opens directly in any browser
- Fully responsive (mobile-first with Tailwind breakpoints)
